mapper.sql: select r.rel_id, r.member_id, r.tag_id, r.source, r.create_by, r.create_time from biz_member_tag_rel r
mapper.select: select r.member_id from biz_member_tag_rel r where r.tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.insert:
insert into biz_member_tag_rel (member_id, tag_id, source, create_by, create_time) values
(#{mid}, #{tagId}, #{source}, #{createBy}, #{now})
mapper.select:
select m.member_id as memberId,
(select count(*) from biz_order o where o.member_id = m.member_id and o.status = 4 and o.is_red = 0 and o.finish_time is not null and o.finish_time >= #{windowStart})
(select coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) from biz_order o where o.member_id = m.member_id and o.status = 4 and o.finish_time is not null and o.finish_time >= #{windowStart})
m.consume_count
m.consume_amount
m.points
m.growth_value
timestampdiff(day, m.register_time, #{now})
as metricValue from biz_member m where m.status <> 4
